plugins.title: Spry importers
plugins.description:
Import unsupported file types directly into Spry as native notes. With a single install, you can bring in:

• EPUB books (.epub)
• OpenDocument text (.odt)
• Rich Text (.rtf)
• Web pages (.html)
• Notion exports (.zip)
• Bear notes (TextPack)

What it does:

• Converts files to notes: Turns your selected documents and archives into native Spry notes.
• Respects your privacy: Only accesses the exact files you choose to import, processing everything inside an isolated background worker.
